Our story

Twenty years in timber. Four years of WeWood.

WeWood grew out of Starwood Veneers, a Kirti Nagar veneer manufacturer of two decades. Four years ago we started shaping that same wood - teak, sheesham and acacia - into furniture and decor of our own, hand-finished with resin.

Before you order

The four questions we get asked most

What does shipping cost?

Standard shipping is ₹99 and free on orders above ₹2,499. Orders are processed within 1 to 2 business days of confirmation.

How long does delivery take?

3 to 5 business days for metro cities, 5 to 7 for tier 2 cities and towns, and 7 to 10 for remote locations. Timelines are estimates and can move with courier delays.

How do I care for the resin and wood?

Wipe with a dry or barely damp cloth and keep pieces out of direct sun where you can. Avoid abrasive cleaners on the resin.

What's your return policy?

We replace or exchange items that arrive damaged or defective within 7 days of delivery, provided they're unused, in original packaging, and reported with photos to support@wewood.co.in. We don't offer returns for other reasons, and made-to-order pieces are excluded unless damaged on arrival.
